customer_acme: Hey team — since yesterday afternoon our prod app started getting intermittent 429s and a bunch of high tail latency. We recently expanded prompts and are sending very large contexts (~100k tokens) to rwd-large-xt. Errors look like rate_limited and occasionally a 401. Can you help troubleshoot?

maria_support: Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste a minimal curl or SDK request that reproduces it and any response body you got? Also include request-id from the response headers if available.

customer_acme: Here's a stripped curl we used (sanitized API key):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-large-xt","input":"<very long prompt here>...","max_tokens":256, "stream":false}'
```

And sample response body we saw: `\{"error\":\"rate_limited\", \"code\":429, \"message\":\"per_model_rpm_exceeded\"\}`. Request-ID header: `req_0a1b2c3d`.

deploy-bot: Received incoming request req_0a1b2c3d routed to shard-7 at 2026-03-16T21:17:12Z

tom_oncall: Long contexts are heavy — even a single 100k request can count as many token-units toward RPM/TPM and can saturate concurrency slots for that model. Per-model limits apply: if you fan out concurrent large-context calls you hit the model's token/req budget quickly. Try limiting client concurrency and add exponential backoff on 429s.

customer_acme: We also saw some 401s mixed in earlier (short window). Could that be a billing/auth break? We didn't rotate keys.

maya_billing: I see a sharp usage spike at 2026-03-16T21:16:30Z that aligns with your timestamps — usage jumped above the free/allocated tier. No key rotation recorded. If your account hit a billing throttle it can cause auth-like failures; I'll dig in. Can you confirm your org id and last 4 of invoice?

sam_engineer: If you can share a few request-ids and the approximate qps pattern we can trace on infra. Common repro: run 6+ concurrent requests at this context and you'll quickly see 429s. Example error we see in traces: `{"status":429,"error":"rate_limited","reason":"per_model_rpm_or_token_burst"}`.

customer_acme: Request-ids: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0a1b2c3e, req_0a1b2c3f. Our client was sending ~10 concurrent requests during the deploy window while prompt expansion increased average context size x4.

jess_product: Immediate mitigations: 1) Client-side concurrency cap (e.g., 3) + jittered exponential backoff on 429s; 2) Chunk or trim long context and cache prefixes where possible; 3) Consider streaming or partial context retrieval so each request is lighter; 4) If this is steady production load, request a Dedicated capacity trial or higher quota for rwd-large-xt. We'll surface model-specific quota increase options.

maria_support: Thanks — I'm escalating this to infra with traces and your request-ids. I've opened S-2026 and flagged it for priority review. Infra will validate whether this was per-model RPM/TPM exhaustion or a transient billing enforcement.

tom_oncall: Quick repro snippet you can run locally to confirm throttling pattern: 

```python
import requests, threading

url = 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate'
headers = {'Authorization':'Bearer ****','Content-Type':'application/json'}
body = {'model':'rwd-large-xt','input':'X'*120000,'max_tokens':64}
def call():
    r = requests.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
    print(r.status_code, r.text[:200])

threads = [threading.Thread(target=call) for _ in range(8)]
for t in threads: t.start()
for t in threads: t.join()
```

If that reproduces 429s, reduce concurrency or context and retry.

customer_acme: We'll try the local repro and implement concurrency cap + backoff now. Thanks — will report back in ~30m.

maya_billing: I've started a billing lookup, will DM with invoice check.

maria_support: Closing the Slack loop for now; ticket S-2026 tracks the infra trace and quota review. Ping here if you still see 429s after the changes :thumbsup:
